title.narrative: UNICEF continued its nutrition cluster-lead role, spearheading both humanitarian and development. Through strong collaboration with key partners including UN agencies, national and international NGOs and MOH, millions of children were reached with lifesaving nutrition-interventions, and the communities and partners were capacity-strengthened to effective, integrated programme delivery approach.
